```{r read in}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
colour_data <- read_csv('../../Data/colour_area.csv')
all_data <- read_csv('../../Data/FINAL_DATA.csv')
```

Validate all the available colour data is in the final sheet. Also create a metadata sheet for colour_area.csv


```{r checks}
jackie_patt <- all_data$Fish[!is.na(all_data$Orange)]
jackie_patt_black <- all_data$Fish[!is.na(all_data$Black)]

setdiff(jackie_patt, jackie_patt_black) #just checking but all fish with colour data have both
all_patt <- colour_data$MHC_ID

missing_ids <- setdiff(all_patt, jackie_patt) # these arwe all the ids we have colour for that aren't reported in the final_data sheet

setdiff(missing_ids, all_data$Fish) #these fish are not present in the dataset, the rest of the colour data fish are accounted for
```
